name: add_tests_java_word_wrap
description: Write plain-java tests for a greedy word-wrap function; java-native harness (exact-width off-by-one, dropped-trailing-line, blank-input mutants)
prompts: WordWrap.wrap(text, width) in WordWrap.java (already correct - do not modify it) greedily packs words onto lines of at most `width` characters (single space between words on a line), never splitting a word - one that's longer than width gets its own overflowing line. Blank/null input gives an empty list. Write a plain-Java test class at exactly WordWrapTest.java (public static void main, throw AssertionError on mismatch, no JUnit) covering at least: a multi-line wrap with an exact expected List<String>, a word that exactly fills the remaining width on a line (must stay on that line, not overflow to the next), the trailing partial line being included in the result, and blank input giving an empty list. The class must exit normally when everything passes.
